test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of people with knowledge of different languages - French, German and English.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5da943dddcb095587535ee98eda071831512005eacd9074c6f3c25d369cd6cfd.png] 

How many people know at least two languages?
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65c6862e1d029643caa34c2670ff0a38dddb26aeb933e3a35d866895b040eac3.png] 

The shaded region represents the total number of people who know at least two languages.

So, the total number of people who know at least two languages = (5 + 18 + 30 + 8) = 61

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
